en.app.rendererError.title: Renderer error
en.app.settingsLoadFailed.title: Could not load settings
en.app.settingsLoadFailed.body: The app could not read your saved settings ({{error}}). It fell back to Chinese. Retry, or check that the app data directory is readable.
en.settings.intro: MCP server, browser startup, archives and build info. Configuration is stored locally. Chromix SDK downloads and optional GeoIP lookups follow your SDK settings.
en.settings.language.title: Language
en.settings.language.desc: Choose the language for the Cloaksession interface. Changes are saved to your settings and apply immediately.
en.settings.language.label: Interface language
en.settings.mcp.title: MCP server
en.settings.mcp.desc: Local HTTP transport that Cursor / Claude Desktop / Cline / any MCP client connects to. Requires the auth token below. The MCP tab has ready-to-paste client configs.
en.settings.mcp.tokenHint: Auth token — required. Send as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Keep it secret.
en.settings.mcp.autostart: Auto-start MCP HTTP transport on app launch
en.settings.engine.title: Browser engine
en.settings.engine.desc: Global startup setting. Restart the app to apply; switching engines keeps each engine's saved configuration.
en.settings.engine.cloakbrowserDesc: Source-patched Chromium from CloakHQ releases. Primary runtime.
en.settings.engine.chromixDesc: Chromix Node SDK with full JSON options and environment configuration.
en.settings.engine.cftDesc: Compatibility fallback using Google's official automation build.
en.settings.chromix.title: Chromix SDK configuration
en.settings.chromix.desc: Full SDK JSON, Node.js runtime and environment overrides. Changes apply after the next app restart.
en.settings.binary.title: Browser binary
en.settings.binary.descChromix: Use a matching Chromix executable. With no custom path, binary resolution and downloads are handled by the Chromix SDK, not the CloakBrowser / Chrome for Testing downloader. Restart the app to apply.
en.settings.binary.descDefault: Point Cloaksession at your own Chromium / CloakBrowser executable instead of auto-downloading. Restart the app to apply.
en.settings.binary.skipDownload: Skip Chromix SDK auto-download (use a local or SDK-cached binary)
en.settings.binary.skipDownloadLegacy: Skip auto-download (use cached binary or the custom path above)
en.settings.binary.offlineNote: For offline Chromix launches, use an installed SDK cache entry, a custom binary path or CLOAKBROWSER_BINARY_PATH in Environment JSON. Launch fails if no local binary is available. The SDK's cache and download settings are separate from the legacy engines.
en.settings.binary.offlineNoteLegacy: When on, Cloaksession never fetches a browser runtime. Launch fails with a clear error if no binary is available. Pair with a custom path for fully offline setups.
en.settings.archives.title: Archives
en.settings.archives.desc: .mzar files are encrypted bundles of profiles — cookies, login state, fingerprints, notes — protected with a passphrase you set at export time.
en.settings.updates.title: Updates
en.settings.updates.descMacos: Auto-install isn't available on macOS yet — we'll notify you in-app to download the new version.
en.settings.updates.descDefault: Cloaksession checks for updates in the background and installs them on restart.
en.settings.telemetry.title: Anonymous usage
en.settings.telemetry.desc: Off by default. Help gauge how many people run Cloaksession.
en.settings.telemetry.heartbeatDesc: When on, sends once a day: app version, OS family, and a random single-use token — no account, no persistent ID, and your IP is never stored (a coarse country is derived server-side then discarded). No profiles, proxies, or browsing are ever included. Set MULTIZEN_NO_TELEMETRY=1 to force it off.
en.settings.about.title: About

zh.app.rendererError.title: 渲染错误
zh.app.settingsLoadFailed.title: 无法加载设置
zh.app.settingsLoadFailed.body: 应用无法读取已保存的设置（{{error}}），已回退为中文。请重试，或检查应用数据目录是否可读。
zh.settings.intro: MCP 服务器、浏览器启动、归档与构建信息。配置保存在本地。Chromix SDK 下载与可选的 GeoIP 查询遵循你的 SDK 设置。
zh.settings.language.title: 语言
zh.settings.language.desc: 选择 Cloaksession 界面的显示语言。更改会保存到设置并立即生效。
zh.settings.language.label: 界面语言
zh.settings.mcp.title: MCP 服务器
zh.settings.mcp.desc: 本地 HTTP 传输，供 Cursor / Claude Desktop / Cline / 任意 MCP 客户端连接。需要下方的认证令牌。MCP 标签页提供可直接粘贴的客户端配置。
zh.settings.mcp.tokenHint: 认证令牌 — 必需。以 Authorization: Bearer <token> 发送，请妥善保管。
zh.settings.mcp.autostart: 随应用启动自动启动 MCP HTTP 传输
zh.settings.engine.title: 浏览器引擎
zh.settings.engine.desc: 全局启动设置。重启应用后生效；切换引擎会保留各引擎已保存的配置。
zh.settings.engine.cloakbrowserDesc: 来自 CloakHQ 发行版的源码补丁版 Chromium。主运行时。
zh.settings.engine.chromixDesc: Chromix Node SDK，支持完整 JSON 选项与环境配置。
zh.settings.engine.cftDesc: 使用 Google 官方自动化构建的兼容回退方案。
zh.settings.chromix.title: Chromix SDK 配置
zh.settings.chromix.desc: 完整 SDK JSON、Node.js 运行时与环境覆盖项。更改在下次重启应用后生效。
zh.settings.binary.title: 浏览器可执行文件
zh.settings.binary.descChromix: 使用匹配的 Chromix 可执行文件。未指定自定义路径时，二进制解析与下载由 Chromix SDK 处理，而非 CloakBrowser / Chrome for Testing 下载器。重启应用后生效。
zh.settings.binary.descDefault: 让 Cloaksession 指向你自己的 Chromium / CloakBrowser 可执行文件，而不是自动下载。重启应用后生效。
zh.settings.binary.pathAria: 浏览器可执行文件路径
zh.settings.binary.skipDownload: 跳过 Chromix SDK 自动下载（使用本地或 SDK 缓存的二进制）
zh.settings.binary.skipDownloadLegacy: 跳过自动下载（使用缓存二进制或上方的自定义路径）
zh.settings.binary.offlineNote: 离线启动 Chromix 时，请使用已安装的 SDK 缓存条目、自定义二进制路径或环境 JSON 中的 CLOAKBROWSER_BINARY_PATH。若无可用本地二进制，启动会失败。SDK 的缓存与下载设置与旧引擎相互独立。
zh.settings.binary.offlineNoteLegacy: 开启后，Cloaksession 不再获取浏览器运行时。若无可用二进制，启动会以明确错误失败。搭配自定义路径可实现完全离线。
zh.settings.archives.title: 归档
zh.settings.archives.desc: .mzar 文件是浏览器配置的加密打包——Cookie、登录态、浏览器指纹、备注——由你在导出时设置的口令保护。
zh.settings.updates.title: 更新
zh.settings.updates.descMacos: macOS 暂不支持自动安装——我们会在应用内提示你下载新版本。
zh.settings.updates.descDefault: Cloaksession 会在后台检查更新，并在重启时安装。
zh.settings.telemetry.title: 匿名使用统计
zh.settings.telemetry.desc: 默认关闭。帮助了解有多少人在使用 Cloaksession。
zh.settings.telemetry.heartbeatDesc: 开启后每天发送一次：应用版本、操作系统类型和一个随机一次性令牌——不包含账号、不包含持久 ID，你的 IP 也不会被存储（服务端会推导出粗略国家后即丢弃）。绝不包含浏览器配置、代理或浏览记录。设置 MULTIZEN_NO_TELEMETRY=1 可强制关闭。
zh.settings.about.title: 关于
zh.update.status.ready: v{{version}} 已就绪 — 重启以更新
